label: Drift: the flags table and the workflow-inputs enumeration disagree in all three /deep command docs. research.md:116 documents --convergence-mode but research.md:97 and the argument-hint at research.md:3 omit it; review.md:87 documents it while review.md:70 and review.md:3 omit it; ai-council.md:88 documents --executor-mode while ai-council.md:69 and ai-council.md:4 omit it. Both flags are live downstream (deep-research-auto.yaml:232 passes --convergence-mode, deep-review-presentation.txt:116 and deep-ai-council-presentation.txt:70 map them), so the enumeration is stale and an operator reading only it loses the flag value and silently gets the default policy.

Drift: --lineage-timeout-hours is documented as the only lineage wall-clock control and is implemented (fanout-run.cjs:3330 parses it, :1809 asserts the 4h hard maximum, fanout-run.vitest.ts:2935 tests the rejection) but no auto flow ever passes it. deep-research-auto.yaml:225-232 threads spec-folder, loop-type, research-topic, fanout-config-json, base-artifact-dir, convergence-threshold, stop-policy and convergence-mode and omits this flag; deep-review-auto.yaml:231/235 likewise carries --review-focus and --stop-policy only. The instruction at review.md:105 to pass a lower N to cap a lineage more tightly cannot be executed from either command.

Drift: ROUTER.md frontmatter is at version 1.6.7.0 and still pins its origin to shared/references/smart-routing.md (v1.0.0.0), while hub-router.json and mode-registry.json are both 1.6.23.0. No validator compares them: rg -l ROUTER.md over runtime/tests and shared returns exactly one file, fanout-run.vitest.ts, and it holds no version-equality assertion.

Drift: the alias vocabulary is authored three times and the registry copy has fallen a third behind. ROUTER.md:65-67 INTENT_SIGNALS and hub-router.json vocabularyClasses agree exactly order-insensitively (11 research, 16 review, 9 ai-council), but mode-registry.json modes[].aliases holds 6/7/5 and is a strict subset: 18 of 36 router keywords are missing and the registry invents none. This is the exact delta the earlier generate-all-three-from-ROUTER.md extension would reconcile.

Improvement: deep-ai-council-auto.yaml:25 declares the input mode in-cli|external-cli (default in-cli) and nothing in the asset reads it - grepping executor.mode/executorMode/in-cli/external-cli returns line 25 only, and the required-values gate at line 111 lists executor but not executor.mode. The YAML layer therefore cannot distinguish an in-cli deliberation from an external spawn, so the declared default is documentation rather than a binding and the in-cli dispatchSeat question from iteration 16 stays open.

direction: fanout-run.cjs rejects the documented kebab-case flags because it reads camelCase keys
reason: parseArgs camel-cases every --kebab-flag at fanout-run.cjs:98 before lookup, so --lineage-timeout-hours, --review-focus, --convergence-mode and --no-resource-map all bind; f-iter025-002 rests on the flag never being passed, not on misnaming
